primary_endpoints: All-request actual robot-task success rate under fixed robot/policy/task/protocol
Task success conditional on valid assembly, reported alongside full denominators
Optional training utility under equal episodes/compute on held-out scenes/tasks
failure_ledger: Separate layout,assetgen,assembly,taskcompile,invalidinitialstate,planning,execution,validator_unknown; retain all requested scenes and objects
task_compilation: Bind target request IDs to actual assets/parts, frames, joints/receptacles/affordances, robot spawn/initial state and required goal predicates. Static mesh alone does not imply articulated manipulation capability.
hard_success_policy: Every mandatory goal predicate must pass. Partial reward,mean requirement score or VLM judgment is a separate diagnostic.
fairness: Match difficulty/goal/robot/policy and budgets. Do not reward dropped objects, oversized rooms, invalid starts silently resampled away, or unsupported tasks omitted from denominators.
